description:
Find places for an intent near a location

The core call. Give one or more categories (exact names like "Coffee", or ids from `list_categories`; all must
match) and a location — a city name or an `area_id` from `list_areas`, or coordinates with a radius — and get
places ranked by Atly's score for those categories, each with quotable reasons from real reviews, a link to
cite, a Google Maps link, whether it is open now, and when Atly added and last refreshed it. The first three
also carry hours, contact and good-to-know. Scores are 0–10 and
relative to other places in the same country; a place with no score is unmeasured, not bad. The order also
weighs how many reviews back each category score (so it is not always by `score`) and, on a gluten-free ask,
its `gluten_free.safety` rating. For most dishes and drinks, classes, tours and event or travel companies rank
lower than the places that serve them, and `doc_notes` names any that moved; to get those, pass `place_type`. If no place matches every category, trailing
categories are dropped until something does (the first is never dropped), and `dropped_categories` says which.
Ranking considers the strongest 100 candidates by Atly's base score (400 with `place_type`); `dropped_categories`
lists the dropped ones as you sent them.

area_id.description: An id from `list_areas`; the search covers that area's viewport. A city name also works ("Austin", "Boise, ID"): it resolves to the matching area, or, for a city with no area, to the extent of the places whose address is in it; the response's `area` and doc_notes say what it resolved to. Give this or lat/lon, not both.

categories.description: Category names or ids, most important first. Every result matches all of them (after any relaxation). A name that is not exact is refused, with the close matches in the error.

limit.description: Places to return, at most 25; a larger value returns 25.

place_type.description: Optional. Keep only places whose Google place type contains one of these words, matched as whole words: "restaurant" keeps "Mexican restaurant" and "Pizza restaurant", "coffee" keeps "Coffee shop", "bar" keeps "Wine bar" but not "Barber shop". A place matches on its main type (`place_type` in results) or any of its other Google types. Use it when the user asks for a kind of venue ("gluten-free restaurants"), not a dish or a feature. Google's types are literal: "Cafe" and "Coffee shop" are different, so for cafes pass both ["cafe", "coffee"]. The filter is applied to the strongest 400 places for the categories and never relaxed.

radius_km.description: Used with lat/lon, in km. Held to 0.2-50 (doc_notes say so when it was).

name: search_places

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north]; absent when unknown and for a circle.

country.description: For a city known only from its places.

id.description: The area's id (list_areas). Absent for a city known only from its places and for a circle.

radius_km.description: For a circle (coordinates given), the radius searched.

region.description: For a city known only from its places, its state or equivalent.

area.description: The resolved search geometry — an area (id, name, level, center, bbox), a city known only from its places (name, level, region, country, center, bbox; no id), or a circle (center, radius_km).

dropped_categories.description: Categories dropped to avoid an empty result, as you sent them (a name or an id).

added_at.description: When Atly added the place. Not a freshness date.

score.description: This category's own 0–10 score. Absent when it fails the test score uses (the place is closed, has under 36 reviews, or too few of its reviews mention this category); reviews is still given. Show no score for it then.

data_refreshed_at.description: When Atly last refreshed the place's data from its sources. Absent when unknown.

distance_km.description: From the search center: the coordinates given, or the area's center (the middle of its bounding box when it has one).

gluten_free.description: Present only for places with a gluten-free identity.

hours.description: Weekly opening hours in the place's local time, one entry per opening (a day can have several). close 24:00 means it closes at midnight; close_day is set when it closes after midnight, on that day. In get_place and the first search results; absent when unknown.

hours_updated_at.description: When the opening hours were last updated. Absent when there are no hours or no date. Over a year old (or absent with hours), say they may have changed and suggest checking with the place.

maps_url.description: Google Maps link for the place (directions), from its Google place id. Not an Atly page: cite url for Atly.

open_now.description: Open at the time of the response, by its hours and timezone; false when the place is closed temporarily or for good. Absent when its hours or timezone are unknown. As fresh as the hours: see hours_updated_at.

kind.description: What the statement is about: Specific Food, Specific Drink, Specific Alcohol (a named dish or drink), Food, Drink, Alcohol, Ambiance, Service, Amenity, Event, Establishment Features or Non-Specific Informative. A gluten-safety warning can carry another, such as Personal Experience, Ambiguous or Other.

reasons.description: Short first-person statements from real reviews, most useful first. Quote them.

score.description: Atly score 0–10 — for the requested categories in search, the overall score in get_place — relative to other places in the same country. Absent when unmeasured (too few reviews, closed, or, in search, a requested category that too few of its reviews mention).

url.description: Canonical Atly page. Link it when you cite. Absent when the place has no page yet.

total_matched.description: How many places match in this area, capped ("1000+"). Absent with `place_type` (the count cannot see place types) or when counting timed out.

title: Search places
